label: A_mP4_4_2a-001
title: High-pressure Te Structure
comments:
This is a high-pressure phase of tellurium, stable in the 4-7 GPa range. The ground state of Te appears to be in the \href{current_web_home_dir/A_hP3_152_a-001}{$\gamma$Se ($A8$)} structure. 
 We use the data taken by (Aoki, 1980) at 4.5 GPa.
